VULN-SQLI-001.description: The function query_users_by_name used Python string formatting to insert user-provided 'name' into an SQL LIKE clause. This allows an attacker to craft input that alters the SQL query semantics, potentially exposing or modifying data.
VULN-SQLI-001.fix: Replaced with a parameterized query: cur.execute("SELECT id, username FROM users WHERE username LIKE ?", (f"%{name}%",)) which avoids SQL injection by separating code from data.
VULN-SQLI-001.risk: High. Direct DB compromise or data exfiltration.

VULN-PICKLE-002.description: The /upload_profile endpoint directly deserialized request.data using pickle.loads. Pickle can execute arbitrary code during deserialization, leading to remote code execution.
VULN-PICKLE-002.fix: Accept only JSON via request.get_json(force=True) and validate the resulting object. Reject other content types.

VULN-CMD-003.description: The /run endpoint concatenated user input into a shell command passed to os.system, enabling command injection.
VULN-CMD-003.fix: Introduce a whitelist of allowed commands and use subprocess.run with a list of args and shell disabled. This prevents shell metacharacters from being interpreted.

VULN-XSS-004.description: The /greet endpoint used render_template_string with unescaped user input leading to reflected XSS.
VULN-XSS-004.fix: Use a template file (greet.html) and render_template, which escapes variables by default. Avoid rendering raw strings containing user input.
VULN-XSS-004.risk: Medium. Client-side script execution and data theft.

VULN-CRED-005.description: The code contained a hardcoded API_KEY and stored a plaintext password for the user 'alice'. This increases the chance that credentials will leak if the repo is shared.
VULN-CRED-005.fix: Remove hardcoded keys from source. Use environment variables or a secrets manager and store passwords as salted hashes in a secure database.
VULN-CRED-005.risk: High. Credential leakage and unauthorized access.

VULN-DEBUG-006.description: The app ran with app.run(debug=True) which can expose the Werkzeug debugger and internal state.
VULN-DEBUG-006.fix: Control debug mode via environment variable and default to False in production.
VULN-DEBUG-006.risk: Medium. Information disclosure and code execution via debugger.
